classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the vertical side as the girl’s height and the labelled base as her shadow, select tangent from the supplied triangle, and calculate and round the height in centimetres.

content.prompt: A girl’s shadow is 60 cm long. If the line joining the top of the girl’s head and the end of the shadow makes an angle of $68^{\circ}$ with the ground, how tall is the girl (correct to the nearest centimetre)?

spec.description: Unshaded triangle ABC with A bottom left, B vertically above A and C bottom right; right angle at A, 68-degree angle at C and AC labelled 60 cm. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: AB is opposite angle ACB; AC is adjacent. AB/AC = tan(68 degrees).
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied labels and givens are visible; the height AB remains unlabelled.

answer.worked:
The girl’s height is $AB$, opposite the $68^{\circ}$ angle; the shadow $AC$ is adjacent.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{AB}{60}&=\tan 68^{\circ}\\AB&=60\tan 68^{\circ}\\AB&\approx149\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The girl is 149 cm tall, to the nearest centimetre.
